title: Pure Designator
summary: The Designator declaration and hand-control build, paired with the Neo Space Connector hand-inspection package and generic staples. By revealing the opponent's hand first, every card-declaration Spell and Trap hits with certainty while locking out key combo pieces.

summary.title: Starters
points: Neo Space Connector Special Summons Neo-Spacian Aqua Dolphin directly from the hand or Deck on Normal Summon.

Neo-Spacian Aqua Dolphin discards a card to look at the opponent's entire hand, destroys a monster with lower ATK than a monster you control, and gives full knowledge of every remaining card for your Designators.
Psi-Blocker declares a card name once per turn so cards with that name and their effects cannot be used until the end of the opponent's next turn.

summary.title: Opening: Neo Space Connector + Designators
steps: Normal Summon Neo Space Connector to Special Summon Neo-Spacian Aqua Dolphin from the Deck, then activate Aqua Dolphin to reveal the opponent's hand and snipe a monster.
Activate D.D. Designator or Set Mind Crush to banish or discard the remaining known cards in their hand.
Declare their remaining starters or board breakers with Prohibition or Psi-Blocker, and Link Summon Ferocious Flame Swordsman using Connector and Aqua Dolphin.

summary.title: Declaration & Deck Manipulation
summary.text: Dark Designator declares a Monster Card name and forces the opponent to add 1 copy of it from their Deck to their hand, immediately setting up a guaranteed hit for D.D. Designator or Mind Crush even before you inspect their hand. Abyssal Designator pays 1000 LP and declares an Attribute and Type to force the opponent to send a matching monster from their hand or Deck to the GY, while Lullaby of Obedience pays 2000 LP and declares a monster name in their Deck so the opponent must either add it to your hand or Special Summon it to your field.

summary.title: Control & Locks
points: Prohibition declares a card name as a Continuous Spell; while face-up, cards with that name cannot be placed on the field, activated, or used as material.
Sales Ban declares a card name to prevent the opponent from activating cards or effects with that name for the rest of the turn, stopping handtraps and board breakers.
Crossout Designator and Called by the Grave are Forbidden since October 2026, so the list runs a third Dark Designator and Abyssal Designator in their place.
Cloak and Dagger declares a monster name as a Continuous Trap and immediately banishes that monster if the opponent summons or flips it face-up.

allow.Neo-Spacian Aqua Dolphin: Discards 1 card to look at the opponent's entire hand and destroys a monster in their hand.
allow.Neo Space Connector: Normal Summon starter that summons Neo-Spacian Aqua Dolphin directly from the Deck to immediately reveal the opponent's hand.
allow.Sales Ban: Declares 1 card name your opponent cannot activate for the rest of the turn.
allow.Cloak and Dagger: Continuous Trap that declares 1 Monster Card name; if the opponent summons or flips that monster face-up, it is immediately banished.
allow.Ferocious Flame Swordsman: Link-2 Warrior made via Neo Space Connector that boosts Warriors by 500 ATK and floats upon destruction.

main: Psi-Blocker
Once per turn declares 1 card name; cards with that name, and their effects, cannot be used until the end of your opponent's next turn.
Neo Space Connector
Summons Neo-Spacian Aqua Dolphin from hand or Deck on Normal Summon to inspect the opponent's hand before activating your Designator cards.
Neo-Spacian Aqua Dolphin
Reveals the opponent's hand so D.D. Designator and Mind Crush never miss.
D.D. Designator
Declares 1 card name and looks at the opponent's hand; if they have the declared card, it is banished immediately.
Dark Designator
Declares 1 Monster Card name; if the opponent has it in their Deck, they must add 1 copy to their hand (setting up Mind Crush or D.D. Designator).
Abyssal Designator
Declares 1 Attribute and Type; forces the opponent to send a monster with that Attribute and Type from their hand or Deck to the GY.
Prohibition
Continuous Spell that declares 1 card name; cards with that name cannot be placed on the field, activated, or used as material while Prohibition is face-up.
Sales Ban
Declares 1 card name to prevent the opponent from activating cards or effects with that name for the rest of the turn.
Lullaby of Obedience
Pays 2000 LP and declares 1 Monster Card name; the opponent must either add it from their Deck to your hand or Special Summon it to your field.
Mind Crush
Declares 1 card name; if that card is in the opponent's hand, they must discard all copies of it to the GY.
Cloak and Dagger
Declares 1 monster name and banishes it if the opponent summons or flips it face-up.
extra: Link-2 Warrior made using Neo Space Connector.
